source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγίες Εκατόν τριάντα γυναίκες»

attestations.note: The life page `/2818/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole account is one sentence: «Οι γυναίκες αυτές πίστεψαν στον Χριστό δια της Αγίας Ιουλιανής (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα) και στη συνέχεια όλες μαρτύρησαν δια αποκεφαλισμού.» **The company enumerates nobody**, so it is held as one entry. Unlike the same day's five hundred martyrs, whose distich names Nicomedia, this distich names no place — «Σὺν πενταπλῇ προὔτεινεν εἰκάδι ξίφει, / Τριπλῇ γυναικῶν μαρτύρων δεκὰς κάρας» — so no place is drafted, and nothing on either page says these women were of the same city or the same hour as those men. No year, no emperor and no hymn, so no `dates` object. The reference to Juliana is the page's own and is the `related` row. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.01.2026 (21. децембар ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Јулијана и шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом.“

attestations.note: The second half of the day’s first heading’s company. The heading gives «шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом» and the body divides it EXACTLY as the corpus already holds it: «пет стотина мушких и стотину тридесет женских» — this folder is the hundred and thirty women and `five-hundred-martyrs-of-nicomedia` the five hundred men, and the `related` rows both already carry to `juliana-of-nicomedia` stand. The quoted heading is the same for all three because the heading is what the book prints. THE HEADING ENUMERATES NOBODY and the body names no woman, so this stays ONE folder. WHAT THE ENTRY GIVES THEM: conversion at the sight of the furnace that did not scorch her, condemnation of the whole number by the eparch, the sword, and Paradise. NO `dates`, for the same reason the five hundred take none: the book’s «304. године» sits in the sentence about HER beheading and is not stated for them. NO SERBIAN NAME FORM: the heading gives a count and not a name. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).
